description: Central registry of all wireframe component definitions. Registered as a singleton DI service. Multiple instances can be registered; when two providers supply the same , the definition from the higher-priority provider wins.

members.name: GetAll
members.description: Returns all registered definitions ordered by Category then DisplayName.

members.name: GetCategories
members.description: Returns all distinct category names in display order.

members.name: GetDef
members.description: Returns the definition for , or null if not found.

members.name: RegisterDefinition
members.description: Registers a single definition. If a definition with the same type already exists, the one with higher wins (ties keep the existing entry).

members.name: RegisterProvider
members.description: Loads all definitions from into the registry.
